title: La Brise
identity: Billaudot identifies Kumiko Tanaka’s La brise for E-flat saxophone and piano, GB7021. Its catalog labels it Cycle 1, facile. A library record dates the edition to 2001 and gives a 2:50 duration, 7-page score, and separate part.

evidence.claim: Billaudot identifies composer, alto saxophone and piano, GB7021, and labels it facile, cycle 1.
National University of Music library record gives publication c2001, duration 2:50, score and part pagination, and “facile (3).”
Windmusic library assigns a repertory year descriptor and documents holdings and edition metadata.

review_focus: Inference: the publisher’s Cycle 1 label and short duration make it a possible contrast piece; inspect the part before judging fit for a college studio.
collection_flag: Publisher explicitly markets this as easy, Cycle 1 repertoire.
gaps: A CMF listing associates it with selection cycles, but its page has inconsistent cycle tags and was not used as a placement claim.
